title: Umami Springy Korean Zucchini Hwajeon
description: A low-fat and flavorful Korean dish featuring cilantro and zucchini, perfect for a date night, with a rich umami taste from the deglaze fond.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine grated zucchini, chopped cilantro, minced garlic, and grated ginger.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce and sesame oil.
Add the soy sauce mixture to the zucchini mixture and stir well.
In a separate large bowl, whisk together rice flour, egg, salt, and black pepper.
Add the dry ingredients to the zucchini mixture and stir until just combined.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and add a small amount of oil.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter into the skillet and flatten slightly.
Cook the hwajeon for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Repeat with the remaining batter, until all the hwajeon are cooked.
Serve the hwajeon hot with a deglaze fond made by reducing soy sauce and sesame oil in the skillet.
